items.text: Hello fellow Reapers!
As always, thank you so much for playing Grim Trials and sending us your feedback! Thanks to your input, we can keep improving the game to make it even better and more enjoyable.
For this October update, we have implemented several improvements:
The game was previously capped at 60 FPS due to technical limitations. We have now fixed this, so you can enjoy Grim Trials at higher framerates!

notes.title: Improved Attack Animation Canceling & Diagonal Movement

items.text: We tried several methods to make movement feel smoother and less clunky, especially during combat. In this month's update, we’ve implemented smoother animation canceling and improved diagonal movement. Let us know if combat feels better on your end!
To keep game progression balanced, we’ve adjusted weapon damage values and tuned several Blessing effects.
Once you head back into the Trial Grounds and try out these changes, please feel free to share your thoughts on the Steam forums or our official Discord community!
In case you missed it, we’re planning a massive update for 2027. You can read more details about that on our previous news here.
Happy playing and happy slaying!

releases.displayName: Update on What's Next for Grim Trials!

items.text: Hi there, Reapers!

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who played Grim Trials! Since launch, we’ve been diving deep into your feedback, reviews, and gameplay clips. We've seen what makes you sweat, what keeps you coming back, and where the experience can be improved. Our team is fully committed to making the game as enjoyable and polished as possible.

notes.title: Based on that, we're excited to let you guys know that Grim Trials will have a MASSIVE update in early 2027!🔥🔥

items.text: We'll be breaking the update into several parts and opening a special playtest branch on Steam. This is so that we won't disrupt your game experience in the default branch, and give us a safe environment to polish our ideas from your feedback before it goes out to the public. We're still preparing all the technical stuff, so we'll let you know as soon as it's ready.
We've made a roadmap so it's easier for us to keep track of what we're planning and what you can expect for future updates:

We're here and are actively listening to your feedback, so please don't hesitate to let us know what you think of Grim Trials, in the comments here or on Steam Discussions. We're also on Discord if you want to discuss all game-related stuff, so don't forget to join and we'll see you there!

If you enjoyed Grim Trials, don't forget to leave a review! Your review means a lot to us and helps the game's visibility, so if you haven't already, please consider doing so and we'll be forever grateful.❤️

Hey there, Reapers!
Thank you so much for playing Grim Trials! We've been keeping up with all of your feedback, and this update aims to address some of the issues you've reported.
Boss Room Visual Cue: Added a clearer visual cue before entering a boss room, so players have a better idea of what they're about to encounter.
Movement Improvements: Reduced several obstacles that could unintentionally interrupt dashes and get the player stuck.

Adjusted melee attack telegraphing and behavior to make dodging feel fairer and more responsive, particularly addressing cases where attacks could feel like they were still tracking the player after they had already dodged.
Acedia: Rebalanced the summoned enemies during the encounter.
We're working on more substantial changes to strengthen Grim Trials as a roguelite and ensure hardcore players find the depth they're looking for.
Revamping the Axe to make it a more distinct and varied melee option.
Expanding the Blessing system with more content, synergies, and effects that have both stronger gameplay and visual impact.
These changes require more in-depth design exploration and planning before we head into development, so we'll share more details only once we have more to show you!
As always, thank you so much for playing Grim Trials and sharing your thoughts. Please feel free to drop by our Discord to chat with us directly, and we'll see you on the Trial Grounds!
Hey there, Reapers!
Thank you so much for playing Grim Trials! We've been reading all your feedback, and this update aims to address some of the issues you've reported.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648502/40cea680f6cd5df814d84b197794af95dd8beec7.png"]
Fixed an issue affecting some players in the late game where Soul Runes could no longer be obtained.
Fixed an issue where Soul Runes removed from the Skill Tree could disappear instead of being refunded correctly.
Fixed an issue that could prevent Crafting from producing an item, effectively blocking players from using the system.
Improved the Gear Enchantment quest and tutorial flow to make the feature easier to understand.
Added clearer terms to ensure players understand how to access Gear Enchantment through the Skill Tree and are less likely to miss the feature during progression.
Adjusted the Crafting Recipe mini game node layout to prevent nodes from overlapping.
Improved recipe readability and navigation when viewing and selecting Crafting Recipes.
Adjusted various Gear buffs and values to improve overall gameplay balance.
Fine-tuned several Gear effects based on player performance and gameplay observations.
Rebalanced several ranged attack combinations to maintain a more engaging and challenging experience during boss encounters.
Adjusted the Anubis Blessing as part of ranged-build balancing.
Adjusted ranged weapon cooldowns to reduce overly powerful attack combinations while maintaining the viability of ranged builds.
Fixed various other issues reported by players following launch.
Additional minor stability, gameplay, and polish fixes.

We're still working on other things such as removing the frame rate cap and improving how attacks are telegraphed. We've also received plenty of feedback regarding Blessings and buffs, so we'll take our time to discuss as a team and evaluate how to improve the game balance.
As always, thank you so much for playing Grim Trials and sharing your thoughts. Please feel free to drop by our Discord to chat with us directly, and we'll see you on the Trial Grounds!

releases.displayName: 💀 Grim Trials - FINAL Demo Update - Remapping and More Languages!

items.text: Hey there, Reapers!

First of all, thank you so much for playing our demo! We've been lurking, reading and noting down your feedback, and though we're on the cusp of launch, we thought it was important to push this update as soon as possible so you can enjoy the academy and we can show our commitment to making Grim Trials the best game possible!
Thanks to all of you who took the time to leave a review, comment, or post, your feedback makes us better 💖
What's new?
1. Gamepad and Keyboard Revamp
The remap button is here! You can finally remap both your gamepad & keyboard bindings
Access the menu via Controls panel on the Pause Menu or Settings menu in the Main Menu
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648502/356251c52ce8027ebf76d23a523fae7e3ae671d2.png"]
Our demo is now available in the following languages: French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Bahasa Indonesia, Brazilian Portuguese, Latin American Spanish
Keyboard: Improved QoL using Keyboard on the UI
Biome generation: Fixed soft lock possibility
Loot: Updated enemy loot drop rate and UI knowledge
Floating Text: Fixed damage number floating text layering
Weapon: Fixed secondary weapon manual aim
Blessing: Fixed to be able to deflect player projectile
We hope you enjoy this final demo update before the full game drops on August 20 :D

Once again, thank you so much for playing the Grim Trials demo during the Steam Next Fest! We heard your feedback loud and clear, and with this update, we bring you improvements on difficulty balancing when facing Acedia.
We adjusted the difficulty and attack patterns, and improved quality of life:
Added a maximum limit on spawned minions
Decreased the number of Eye Hazards in the 2nd phase (Eye Hazard = oval-shaped ground damage from the boss)
Added a visual cue for the Eye Hazard boss attack
Adjusted the boss's idle time between attacks to give players a larger attack window
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648502/4b8ec382f2b7af8d05ad61626e4cd4ddc5c0acf1.gif"]

As for the control remapping, we're in the process of implementing it and we will add it in a future update!

items.text: Craven monsters and scornful sinners alike prowl the Grounds, each thirsting for a fight with a worthy Reaper.
Hey everyone!

We recently launched a community playtest on Discord to gather feedback on our brand new demo, and now we're excited to finally share it with everyone! We're SO grateful to those of you who participated and shared your thoughts during the playtest. We hope you enjoy it! 💜
Now, let's jump into the new demo updates!⚔️

notes.title: New Attack Combos & Expanded Skill Tree

items.text: Skill Tree values have been adjusted, nodes have been expanded, and we’ve added a major new node: Attack Combos. The Skill Tree now goes far beyond simple stat increases, allowing you fine-tune Avelin's fighting style.

We heard you loud and clear: shooting a crossbow while moving feels badass. We totally agree, so we’ve officially implemented it in this update! Experience more fluid, run-and-gun combat as you riddle your foes with bolts.

More pieces of gear now have their own unique effect when on the Trial Grounds. When these gear effects are triggered, you’ll now see a clear visual indication, making it easier to track your power-ups in the heat of battle.
Potions: limited to 12 max per slot, per run. No more drinkmaxxing!
Crafting: tweaked recipe ingredients for a smoother progression
Blessings: adjusted appearance rate multiplier
Blessings: added VFX for Arawn, Manaan, Morigan, and Thanatos blessing
Bosses: added stun immunity
Gear: adjusted various gear stats and their effect scalings
Main Menu: added new BGM for extra heavy metal vibe 🤘
What do you think? Come re-enter the Trial Grounds and let us know your thoughts!
